blocks.x: Broker email intake automated end to end — quote turnaround from three days to same-day on 70% of standard risks
a commercial P&C insurer whose brokers emailed risk submissions and whose underwriters retyped them into the rating system, sometimes twice. Figures are the client's own, shared with permission.
The baseline fortnight measured the retyping: 68% of submissions arrived by email, extraction to the rating system took a median 3.1 days, and 9% of quotes went out with fields the broker never sent.
Standard risks and complex risks queued identically. Underwriters spent mornings on data entry for risks a trainee could quote, afternoons on the complex ones the queue had aged.

We rebuilt intake as an extraction-and-routing pipeline: submissions parsed into a structured risk record with confidence per field, standard risks quoted automatically within appetite rules the underwriting committee signed, complex risks routed with their extracted file attached, and every auto-quote logged with its rule trail for the committee's monthly read.
